scope: Fresh 2.1 revision verification. Earlier core-runtime and full analysis evidence is separately identified and was not rerun in full.

freshChecks.environment: WorkspaceStore with fake-indexeddb and controlled localStorage
Actual HTML, app.js and vendored CodeMirror under jsdom; controlled REngine double

checks: Rebuilt visual fields preserve values, keys and secondary indexes
Exact fallback retains the original R parse tree
Namespace survives rebuilding when an unqualified function name is masked

freshChecks.note: Regenerated behavior cases were rerun separately in actual R. This does not claim a new full run of the 23 core production-runtime groups. Individual outcomes in runtime-verification.json remain historical.

freshChecks.lineEndings: LF uses parse(text); CRLF/CR fixtures use R file-input handling

report.name: file-based non-syntactic and Unicode names, safe backticks, and deterministic collisions
R AST detects package calls while ignoring comments, strings, quotes, and dynamic names
automatic package-install request, dynamic library loading, and recoverable install diagnostics
imported, built-in, and last-run object previews preserve the pipeline result
analysis captures console and warnings with data.table mutation and error isolation
runs, previews, and analyses use one serialized execution queue
completions combine user objects and loaded exports; package help is read from R documentation
example table deletion removes session bindings and completions while preserving results and uploads
deletion removes the correct symbol and file and survives runtime restart

checks.evidence: Prior 2.0 verification summary retained in verification.md under Carried-forward 2.0 evidence

carriedForward.historicalReportNote: The unchanged baseline JSON also retains eight earlier feature groups and 201 earlier operation outcomes; fresh reports do not rewrite those entries.

environment.packageDelivery: Compatible Wasm R packages mounted locally because the Node downloader could not use the environment network proxy

unverified: Browser image-bitmap transfer and chart canvas appearance
Native browser storage quota, eviction and durability behavior

limitations: Check types overlap; counts must not be summed as distinct application features.
DOM tests use jsdom and a controlled R-engine double; storage tests use fake-indexeddb and controlled localStorage.
Package tests cover discovery, installation requests, compatible local execution and errors, not first-time browser downloads.
No deployment, cross-browser certification, performance benchmark or practical dataset-size guarantee was performed.
The full 48-case analysis and 23-group core-runtime suites were carried forward, not rerun in full.

prerequisites: npm install for DOM/storage development dependencies
npm install --no-save webr@0.6.0 for actual R tests
TABLECRAFT_R_LIBRARY can point to compatible unpacked Wasm packages; parser.webr.mjs expects data.table and magrittr in its webR library
